copy.headline: 1 man sentenced after feds arrest 8 'known gang members' in Dallas, seizing guns, drugs and a live alligator
copy.caption: One of eight members of the 42 Oakland Crips gang in Dallas has pleaded guilty after being arrested during "Operation Blue Laces," officials said.
